name: omnigent
description: Omnigent agent sessions for the app's users on the workspace's managed Omnigent: Claude Agent SDK, Pi and OpenAI Agents SDK on Databricks Sandboxes, with models through Unity Gateway

must: Enable the Omnigent and Databricks Sandbox previews in the workspace
Account admin: add all-apis to the app's OAuth integration (databricks account custom-app-integration update)
